name: Gear For Sports Inc
old_description: We truly understand the fundamentals of decorated garments. Gear products are tailored from only the finest fabrics and offer the most innovative decoration opportunities. Our customers have a unique and important message to deliver and our designs are best suited to deliver that message.
about:
Gear For Sports Inc. operates from Lenexa, Kansas, as a subsidiary of Unrivaled Teamwear LLC. The company focuses on decorated garments and sportswear, though its founding date and original founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company offers a portfolio of sportswear brands including Under Armour, Champion, Comfort Wash, and its own Gear for Sports label. Its product range spans t-shirts, caps, fleece, performance wear, and outerwear, all emphasizing decorated garment capabilities such as custom graphics and innovative decoration techniques. Specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Gear For Sports serves customers seeking branded sportswear and teamwear, including organizations, teams, and retailers that require decorated apparel. The company positions itself as a single resource for sportswear needs across its brand portfolio, though specific industry verticals or named clients are not listed.

According to the company, its differentiation lies in a deep understanding of decorated garment fundamentals, use of premium fabrics, and innovative decoration opportunities. It claims that other sportswear brands cannot match its level of service across a breadth of accounts, providing customers with a single source for all sportswear requirements.
